d: Mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ke khilaph keral sarkar ne 20 sal purane mamle men satarkata janch ke nirdesh die hain. yah mamla 2006 ke keral stet transport projekt (KSTP) aur maleshiyaee projekt mainejar li si bin ki aatmahatya se jura hai. sipiaaee(em) neta thomas aaijaik ke phesbuk post aur ek thekedar dvara lagae gae 2 karor rupye rishvat ke nae aaropon ke bad grih vibhag ne satarkata evan bhrashtachar nirodhak byuro (VACB) ko prathmik janch saunp di hai. kya tha 2006 ka pura vivad, kyon atka tha projekt aur ab janch ke kya mayne hain? dekhie 'lal batti' men puri partal.
